content.short: BlockOwls as a project is a story-based NFT adventure on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
The main goal is to make a playful and vivid fictional world - filled with a variety of characters with colorful appearance and personalities that we can share with each other. The BlockOwls are the first and main characters in this story. It's still unknown where this project will take us as this is just the beginning, but we hope you will join and be a part of this universe.

We are a group of artists and CNFT enthusiasts with a huge passion for creating stories and visual concepts. We have over 75 years of experience in the field of Motion Design, animation and sound. The team members have worked on projects for some of the largest brands in the world.

BlockOwls started as a personal project, as a contribution to the Cardano ecosystem, but the team has grown from 1 to 11 in just a few months. BlockOwls is a project with a focus on visual storytelling, NFTs and bringing joy to the Cardano community. We hope BlockOwls attracts other creatives, project owners and blockchain (Cardano) nerds so that we, together, can make this even bigger.
